| Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|

| Pilot mass with hang point | 60–114 kg | **estimate**: DHV “Startgewicht” 85–139 kg minus wing mass 25.2 kg ([card DHV 01-0457-10](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE); no hook-in figure in the passport) |
| Double surface | 25 % of span | **passport**: [card DHV 01-0457-10](https://service.dhv.de/db1/technicsearchpage.php?lang=DE) “25.0 %” |
| Kingpost | yes (kingposted) | **passport**: quote from the manufacturer's page: [aeros.com.ua](https://www.aeros.com.ua/structure/hg/fox_en.php) |

| Years of production | unknown | **estimate**: not in the passports or the sample |
| Trim speed | 34 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Target 16 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0288) |
| Speed, control frame fully pulled in | 78.8 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Target 16 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0288) |
| Stall (straight flight) | 30.6 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Target 16 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0288) |
| Minimum sink | 1.24 m/s at 32 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Target 16 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0288) |
| Glide ratio | 7.3 at 35.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Aeros Target 16 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0288); scaling does not change the glide ratio — same as the base |
